title: Circumcision
summary: Circumcision was the covenant sign given to Abraham and his male descendants.
background: In the New Testament, circumcision becomes a major issue in debates about Gentile believers, law, covenant identity, and the sufficiency of Christ.
teachingHelp: When teaching circumcision passages, distinguish Abrahamic covenant sign, Mosaic-law debates, and the New Testament focus on the heart and Christ.
